from app.service import run
from fixture_api.runtime import X20Service

cases = [
    ('duplicate mode', 'reader', [('mode', 'read'), ('mode', 'write')], {'error': 'bad-fields'}),
    ('unknown field', 'reader', [('x', 'y')], {'error': 'bad-fields'}),
    ('forbidden write', 'reader', [('mode', 'write')], {'error': 'forbidden'}),
    ('defaults', 'reader', [], {'mode': 'read', 'tags': []}),
    ('ordered tags', 'reader', [('tag', 'a'), ('tag', 'b'), ('tag', 'a')], {'mode': 'read', 'tags': ['a', 'b', 'a']}),
]
for label, principal, fields, expected in cases:
    actual = run(X20Service(), principal, fields)
    assert actual == expected, (label, actual, expected)
print('targeted checks passed')
PY"
